restriction_review.scope: Nineteen absent OoW Baking Crunch formulas, all exact primary output identities and numeric trivial162. Six existing same-name formulas are not duplicated: their missing Vegetable Oil component quantity is separately prepared for correction.
restriction_review.quantity: Literal consume Vegetable Oil3 and return Vegetable Oil2 on success, plus one manufactured Crunch. Oil and food are stackable native items; quantities are physical units. No failure return stated or invented. Other inputs one ice cream, one frosting, one bread.
restriction_review.era: Positive maintained OoW8 Baking family; floor8/max-1 labelled reconstruction, not exact introduction or immutable May2013 fields.
restriction_review.gates: Source omits mandatory minimum, learning and actor restrictions. Ordinary skillneeded0/must_learn0/book0/quest0/enabled1/nofail0 conventions; no class gate inferred from item use.
restriction_review.containers: Every selected source explicitly permits ordinary Oven15, six physical input units fit ten-slot native world trade container. Source Spit/Tanaan/Collapsible/placeable/guild alternatives held separately; no availability inferred.
restriction_review.preservation: 53 full native dependencies, 39 fresh and14 pinned reused. Current all-state/all-skill full-input bodies absent. All success roles including returned Oil audited: nine existing recipes/66entries captured and guarded unchanged. Six old Crunch ingredient defects remain separate, no duplicate formulas created.
restriction_review.execution: Source only pending exact publication and SQL GO; named one-pass count contract. Readers and research tabs closed. No native gameplay acceptance, scope remains incomplete.
